title: The Zero-Cost Zen Master
description: Alright, fresh meat. Welcome to Vishwakarma! This ain't your grandma's school CMS, we make magic happen.
panel_text: Repo Guide, a dishevelled but cool dev, gestures wildly at a gleaming 'Vishwakarma' logo.
speech_bubble: Repo Guide, a dishevelled but cool dev, gestures wildly at a gleaming 'Vishwakarma' logo.

flowchart TD
    Repo[Repository]
    _env_template[".env.template"]
    _github[".github"]

    Dockerfile["Dockerfile"]
    Repo --> _env_template
    Repo --> _github
    Repo --> _planning

title: The Data Dynamo
description: Forget databases. Our school CMS pulls content from Google Drive! Check the `public` directory or `index.html` for views.
panel_text: A simplified diagram shows an arrow from a cloud labelled 'Google Drive' pointing to a browser displaying a school website.
speech_bubble: A simplified diagram shows an arrow from a cloud labelled 'Google Drive' pointing to a browser displaying a school website.

title: React-ion Time!
description: Under the hood, it's pure React 19 power. Customizing the website? Just tweak `src/siteConfig.js`, it's that simple.
panel_text: Code snippets visible with a 'React 19' logo, showing an open `src/siteConfig.js` file with configurable options.
speech_bubble: Code snippets visible with a 'React 19' logo, showing an open `src/siteConfig.js` file with configurable options.

title: Deploy, Dev, & Dominate
description: Deployment? GitHub Pages, baby! Check `deploy.yml` or `README.md` for a quick start. Get your scripts running!
panel_text: A celebratory scene with a 'Deployed!' banner, a happy dev, and a badge showing 'GitHub Actions' success.
speech_bubble: A celebratory scene with a 'Deployed!' banner, a happy dev, and a badge showing 'GitHub Actions' success.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    Dev["Developer"] --> Read["Read docs"]
    Read --> Code["Write css, gs, html, js, json, jsx, md, mmd, py, template, toml, txt, yml code"]
    Code --> Ship["Ship changes"]
